title: Exactly Two Bits Set
constraints: `two = 1` exactly when `x` has **exactly two** bits set.
Purely combinational. No loops or generate, no `$countones` / `$onehot`, and no popcount adder tree (it works, but it isn't the trick).
hints: After clearing the lowest set bit, a two-hot value becomes one-hot.
`y = x & (x - 1)`. Then x is two-hot iff y ≠ 0 and y is a power of two: `(y & (y - 1)) == 0`.
The one-hot detector is the same trick applied once.
